verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official MCP server in its XeroAPI GitHub org that bridges MCP to Xero's accounting API, covering contacts, chart of accounts and invoices. It is documented on developer.xero.com under tools/mcp-server and promoted as part of Xero's AI Toolkit. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented setup/auth details and full tool coverage.
